edits.new: For every required ancestor or descendant relationship, repeat the same counterexample tests, including concrete tests of applicable identity or consumer restrictions absent from that child's explicit wording. Resolve these cases in `reason`; passing the selected-node comparison does not discharge them. A reused counterexample must satisfy the particular child and escape the particular parent being tested. Intermediate nodes do not prevent containment. Never approve a relation whose required consequence fails or remains unresolved. A relevant branch conflict or unresolved consequence requires `uncertain`; settled answers about the selected meanings may remain settled.
